text:
marta: Heads-up — AcmeRetail Dedicated pool is seeing higher tail latency under sustained QPS when KV cache prefetch is enabled. Requesting a token-budget/queue tweak and a kernel selection sanity check.
kevin: Can you paste the perf profile and current batch settings?
marta: Profile snip below (from local run against dedicated replica):
```
90th: 125ms  95th: 210ms  99th: 480ms
Median token latency: 8.2ms/token
Observed batch sizes: mean 11, p95 32, p99 60
KV cache hit-rate: 0.72 (but hot-key skew on product descriptions)
Queue depth avg: 18, max burst: 110 tokens
Kernel used: fused-attn-v2 (fp16-q4) fallback to generic-matmul on long sequences
```
marta: Current dedicated config (simplified):
```json
{"token_budget_target": 500000, "max_queue_tokens": 120000, "per_request_token_cap": 2048, "kv_prefetch_enabled": true, "kv_pin_top_n": 0}
```
jonathan: Noted. Two issues jump out: 1) big bursts push continuous-batcher to large multi-request batches which hurts kernel path selection (fused-attn overflows and falls back). 2) KV prefetch increases memory pressure and evictions cause extra KV lookups mid-response.
kevin: Proposed conservative adjustments to test with AcmeRetail: reduce token_budget_target and cap queue tokens per-worker. Also suggest pinning top-50 hot keys to avoid mid-request cache churn.
lucy: +1 on pinning. We saw similar pattern with BetaPay. Pinning fixed p95 by ~25ms in that case.
aisha: Any change to batching heuristics? Maybe lower max_batch_time and prefer smaller early dispatch to avoid fallback to generic kernels.
kevin: Draft patch for dedicated config to try in canary (small pool):
```json
{"token_budget_target": "300000", "max_queue_tokens": "60000", "per_request_token_cap": "1024", "max_batch_time_ms": "8", "min_batch_size": "4", "kv_prefetch_enabled": "true", "kv_pin_top_n": "50", "queue_policy": "fifo_weighted"}
```
marta: Added notes from profiler: fallback hot path correlated with batches > 48 seq_len and batch_size > 24. Kernel selection logs:
```
[perf-bot] kernel_select: fused-attn-v2 selected for (seq=128,batch=16)
[perf-bot] kernel_select: fallback generic-matmul for (seq=512,batch=28) -> +2.3x latency
```
perf-bot: alert: memory pressure > 78% during burst windows, likely due to KV prefetch threads + large batch KV cache allocations.
jonathan: For canary, let's also enable batch-optimizer telemetry to capture kernel choice vs (batch,seq) bins. We need concrete thresholds to auto-split batches when kernel would fallback.
kevin: Agree. Short-term: manual caps and pin_top_n=50. Medium-term: add kernel-aware batch splitter: if predicted kernel fallback, split batch into smaller ones up to N workers.
aisha: Who's going to file the Dedicated config change + rollout?
marta: I'll open the config PR and schedule canary deploy tonight to the AcmeRetail dedicated pool (pool-id: da-73).
kevin: Ping @deploy-bot with deploy window and link. Also include rollback plan: revert token_budget and kv_pin in 30m if p95 increases.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to pool da-73 at 23:00 UTC. Health checks: p50/p95/p99, kernel_fallback_rate, kv_hitrate. Auto-rollback after 30m on p95 regression > 10%.
johnathan: tiny typo: I think you meant "jonathan" above ;)
jonathan: lol noted.
lucy: After canary, if it looks good can we try pin_top_n=100? Might help more but watch memory.
marta: Will report back with telemetry snapshot and kernel-aware batch heatmap. Thanks all :thumbsup:
